items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Pete Rugalo wrote a tune for the interviewee; Interviewee responds about 'he' (Rugalo) being a great musician/perfectionist, but does not describe a direct personal or professional interaction.

ctx.x: Now, I understand he saw that January 24 concert, so that means he must have had Pete Rugalo write that tune within two or three weeks and he recorded it three weeks later. Ahhh, how does that make you feel, somebody paying that kind of tribute to you?
Such a great musician like, because he was a perfectionist. He was very, very dedicated and he has a young musician that was something else, good musician, good legitimate musician.
